item.title: Cardano Rallies as Injective Testnet Boosts Cross-Chain Growth
item.summary: Cardano’s native token, ADA, posted strong gains over a 24-hour period, rising approximately 6.5% to around $0.1999 while significantly outperforming Bitcoin, which remained largely unchanged during the same timeframe.
